passages.text: Early the next morning Joshua got up and left Shittim with all the Israelites. They went as far as the Jordan, where they camped before crossing over.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of the Israelites.
Early in the morning, Joshua got up.
He left Shittim.
All the Israelites went with him.
They traveled to the Jordan River.
Joshua and all the Israelites reached the Jordan.
They camped there.
They stayed at the camp before crossing the river.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ בַּבֹּ֜קֶר וַיִּסְע֣וּ מֵֽהַשִּׁטִּ֗ים וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ עַד־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן ה֖וּא וְכָל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּלִ֥נוּ שָׁ֖ם טֶ֥רֶם יַעֲבֹֽרוּ׃

passages.text: After three days the officers went through the camp and commanded the people: “When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God being carried by the Levitical priests, you are to set out from your positions and follow it.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites camped by the Jordan River.
Three days passed.
The officers walked through the camp.
The officers spoke to the people.
They gave a command.
They said, “Watch for the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God.
The Levitical priests will carry the ark.
When you see the ark, leave your places.
Follow the ark.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֕י מִקְצֵ֖ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַיַּעַבְר֥וּ הַשֹּׁטְרִ֖ים בְּקֶ֥רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃ וַיְצַוּוּ֮ אֶת־ הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹר֒ כִּרְאֽוֹתְכֶ֗ם אֵ֣ת אֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נֹשְׂאִ֖ים אֹת֑וֹ וְאַתֶּ֗ם תִּסְעוּ֙ מִמְּק֣וֹמְכֶ֔ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֖ם אַחֲרָֽיו׃

passages.text: But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between yourselves and the ark. Do not go near it, so that you can see the way to go, since you have never traveled this way before.”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites followed the ark of the covenant.
The ark showed them where to go.
God commanded the people to keep a distance from the ark.
They must stay about two thousand cubits away from the ark.
They must not go near the ark.
This distance helped them see the right path.
They needed to see the way because they had never traveled this road before.
passages.original: אַ֣ךְ׀ רָח֣וֹק יִהְיֶ֗ה בֵּֽינֵיכֶם֙ וּבֵינוֹ כְּאַלְפַּ֥יִם אַמָּ֖ה בַּמִּדָּ֑ה אַֽל־ תִּקְרְב֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו לְמַ֤עַן אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ־ בָ֔הּ כִּ֣י לֹ֧א עֲבַרְתֶּ֛ם בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ מִתְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃ס

passages.text: Then Joshua told the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of the Israelites.
Joshua spoke to all the people.
He said, “Set yourselves apart for God.
Tomorrow the LORD will do amazing things among you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל־ הָעָ֖ם הִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ כִּ֣י מָחָ֗ר יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֖ם נִפְלָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And he said to the priests, “Take the ark of the covenant and go on ahead of the people.” So they carried the ark of the covenant and went ahead of them.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel after Moses.
Joshua spoke to the priests.
He gave them a command.
He said, “Take the ark of the covenant.”
He said, “Go ahead of the people.”
The priests took the ark of the covenant.
The priests went ahead of the people.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים לֵאמֹ֔ר שְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית וְעִבְר֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃ס

passages.text: Now the LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you just as I was with Moses.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Joshua.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said, “Today I will begin to make you great.
All the people of Israel will see this.
They will know that I am with you.
I was with Moses before you.
I will be with you in the same way.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה אָחֵל֙ גַּדֶּלְךָ֔ בְּעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ יֵֽדְע֔וּן כִּ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיִ֛יתִי עִם־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: Command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant: ‘When you reach the edge of the waters, stand in the Jordan.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Joshua.
God gave Joshua a command.
Joshua must command the priests.
The priests are carrying the ark of the covenant.
Joshua must say to the priests, “When you reach the edge of the Jordan River, stand in the Jordan.”
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה תְּצַוֶּה֙ אֶת־ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֥י אֲרֽוֹן־ הַבְּרִ֖ית לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּבֹאֲכֶ֗ם עַד־ קְצֵה֙ מֵ֣י הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן בַּיַּרְדֵּ֖ן תַּעֲמֹֽדוּ׃פ

passages.text: So Joshua told the Israelites, “Come here and listen to the words of the LORD your God.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel after Moses.
Joshua spoke to the Israelites.
He said, “Come here.”
He said, “Listen to the words of the LORD your God.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גֹּ֣שׁוּ הֵ֔נָּה וְשִׁמְע֕וּ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: He continued, “This is how you will know that the living God is among you and that He will surely drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.
passages.sermon:
Joshua spoke to the Israelites.
He said, “You will know something important now.
You will know that God is alive.
God is among you.
God will drive out your enemies before you.
God will remove the Canaanites.
God will remove the Hittites.
God will remove the Hivites.
God will remove the Perizzites.
God will remove the Girgashites.
God will remove the Amorites.
God will remove the Jebusites.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בְּזֹאת֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּן כִּ֛י אֵ֥ל חַ֖י בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְהוֹרֵ֣שׁ יוֹרִ֣ישׁ מִ֠פְּנֵיכֶם אֶת־ הַכְּנַעֲנִ֨י וְאֶת־ הַחִתִּ֜י וְאֶת־ הַחִוִּ֗י וְאֶת־ הַפְּרִזִּי֙ וְאֶת־ הַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֔י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃

passages.text: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth will go ahead of you into the Jordan.
passages.sermon:
Joshua spoke to the Israelites.
Joshua said, “Look.
The ark of the covenant is here.
The ark belongs to the Lord.
The Lord is the Lord of all the earth.
The ark will go ahead of you.
The ark will enter the Jordan River before you.”
passages.original: הִנֵּה֙ אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית אֲד֖וֹן כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ עֹבֵ֥ר לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם בַּיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

passages.text: Now choose twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one from each tribe.
passages.sermon:
Joshua spoke to the people of Israel.
He gave them a command.
He told them to choose twelve men.
These men must come from the tribes of Israel.
Each tribe must provide one man.
There must be one man from each tribe.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה קְח֤וּ לָכֶם֙ שְׁנֵ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר אִ֔ישׁ מִשִּׁבְטֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֖ד לַשָּֽׁבֶט׃

passages.text: When the feet of the priests who carry the ark of the LORD—the Lord of all the earth—touch down in the waters of the Jordan, its flowing waters will be cut off and will stand up in a heap.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the Lord of all the earth.
The priests carry the ark of the LORD.
The priests will step into the waters of the Jordan River.
When the priests’ feet touch the water, something will happen.
The waters of the Jordan will be cut off.
The water that flows down from upstream will stop.
The water will stand up in a single heap.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֡ה כְּנ֣וֹחַ כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאֵי֩ אֲר֨וֹן יְהוָ֜ה אֲד֤וֹן כָּל־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ בְּמֵ֣י הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן מֵ֤י הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יִכָּ֣רֵת֔וּן הַמַּ֥יִם הַיֹּרְדִ֖ים מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְיַעַמְד֖וּ נֵ֥ד אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: So when the people broke camp to cross the Jordan, the priests carried the ark of the covenant ahead of them.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel broke camp.
They prepared to cross the Jordan River.
The priests led the way.
The priests carried the ark of the covenant.
The priests walked in front of the people.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּנְסֹ֤עַ הָעָם֙ מֵאָ֣הֳלֵיהֶ֔ם לַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים נֹֽשְׂאֵ֛י הָאָר֥וֹן הַבְּרִ֖ית לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: Now the Jordan overflows its banks throughout the harvest season. But as soon as the priests carrying the ark reached the Jordan and their feet touched the water’s edge, the flowing water stood still. It backed up as far upstream as Adam, a city in the area of Zarethan, while the water flowing toward the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea ) was completely cut off. So the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
passages.sermon:
The Jordan River overflows its banks during the entire harvest season.
The priests carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
The priests reached the Jordan River.
The priests’ feet touched the edge of the water.
The water flowing from upstream stopped.
The water stood still in one heap.
The water backed up a great distance.
It reached as far as Adam, a city near Zarethan.
The water flowing down toward the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, was completely cut off.
The people crossed over the Jordan River.
They crossed opposite Jericho.
passages.original: וּכְב֞וֹא נֹשְׂאֵ֤י הָֽאָרוֹן֙ עַד־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְרַגְלֵ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ נֹשְׂאֵ֣י הָֽאָר֔וֹן נִטְבְּל֖וּ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַמָּ֑יִם וְהַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן מָלֵא֙ עַל־ כָּל־ גְּדוֹתָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י קָצִֽיר׃ וַיַּעַמְד֡וּ הַמַּיִם֩ הַיֹּרְדִ֨ים מִלְמַ֜עְלָה קָ֣מוּ נֵד־ אֶחָ֗ד הַרְחֵ֨ק מְאֹ֜ד בָאָדָם הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִצַּ֣ד צָֽרְתָ֔ן וְהַיֹּרְדִ֗ים עַ֣ל יָ֧ם הָעֲרָבָ֛ה יָם־ הַמֶּ֖לַח תַּ֣מּוּ נִכְרָ֑תוּ וְהָעָ֥ם עָבְר֖וּ נֶ֥גֶד יְרִיחֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan, while all Israel crossed over the dry ground, until the entire nation had crossed the Jordan.
passages.sermon:
The priests carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
They stood firmly on dry ground.
They stood in the middle of the Jordan River.
All Israel crossed over the dry ground.
The people crossed until the entire nation had finished crossing the Jordan.
passages.original: וַיַּעַמְד֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹ֠שְׂאֵי הָאָר֨וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֜ה בֶּחָֽרָבָ֛ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן הָכֵ֑ן וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֹֽבְרִים֙ בֶּחָ֣רָבָ֔ה עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֙מּוּ֙ כָּל־ הַגּ֔וֹי לַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
